set_value.name: $Difficulty
set_value.exact: if event.param.$Difficulty? then event.param.$Difficulty else level.medium

set_value.name: $HasError
set_value.comment: will be set true if any setup fails

create_group.comment: add objects which trigger mission failure/success on destruction

debug_text.text: 'Scenario has been successfully set up and can start'

do_if.comment: more than 2 attemps and best rating less than 3

signal_cue_instantly.comment: mission timer is started when the scenario starts BUT timers for scoring starts at these times: (1) rescue scenario: when the player first undocks from the disabled station, (2) engineer scenario: when the player first spacewalks, (3) escort scenario: when the player's ships first detects the blockade OR, in case the escort doesn't patrol the blockade, when the AI engineer enters the station. mission timer is started when the scenario starts IN CASE the player doesn't do any of the above. $IsReset is called so that MissionTime_Start is set to any of the 3 conditions above. this reset can only happen once.

event_cue_signalled.comment: only accept signals to end mission to allow the station destruction cutscene to play

set_value.name: $ResultData.$PlayerDied
set_value.comment: always accept that the player never dies UNLESS the station or ship they are in is destroyed or they have no object context - unless the player is at the disabled station. when at the disabled station, the station destruction's cutscene will play anyway.

set_value.name: $ResultData.$CustomStats.$Score_Step1_KillScore_99_Final
set_value.comment: Score_Step1_KillScore_99_Final is player's total score based on number of kills * maxscore. and Score_Step2_Efficiency_99_Final = THAT score * efficiency factor = the players TOTAL score. because stats need to be addends, make Score_Step1_KillScore_99_Addend = first score component = kill score * half max score. therefore Score_Step2_Efficiency_99_Addend = Score_Step2_Efficiency_99_Final - Score_Step1_KillScore_99_Addend.

do_if.comment: too high kill-rate with too few kills to get an effective kill rate. 4 is arbitrary but is half the raiders of wave 1. if efficiency gt 1.5, cap time factor to 1.5 - i.e. kill rate is capped at 66% optimal kill rate. this allows a kill-rate higher than 66% optimal but only when efficiency is less than 150% or with more kills. this effectively, but indirectly, caps efficiency at 150%. this method looks more natural because as time progress in the mission, high kill-rates becomes less likely because raider spawns at 1minute interval - more than the expected 22s kill rate. and capping efficiency directly at 1.5 (i.e. 150%) will be unfair because there will only be a low number of kills. an unreasonable score can result when a low number of kills occur at a very high kill rate before player-death. e.g. 2 kills within 5s and player-death soon after the 2 kills result in a very high kill rate/efficiency

test for kills AND test for score. during tests to acquire $Time_PerKill_Optimal, scoring method (i.e. $Time_PerKill_Optimal) changes. but fundamentally (i.e. once best $Time_PerKill_Optimal is identified, i.e. post-tests, i.e. live), better kills results in better scores.

set_value.name: $IsCustomOutroMusic
set_value.comment: custom outro music if rating lt 1 AND station has already been destroyed. i.e. do not play failure outro music after station has been destroyed because that cutscene plays the same outro music. i.e. play the failure outro music IF rating is lt 1 AND station is still active. i.e. the player died with rating of lt 1.
